PersonalHub read this receipt on your device. Review the detected purchases before saving.
Optional. Local receipt import stays available when this is off.

WITHOUT CHATGPT
PersonalHub reads the receipt on this device, tries to find the shop, date, total and products, and reuses products it already knows. You can review and correct everything before saving. This works without a ChatGPT account, paid plan or internet connection.

WITH CHATGPT
If you turn this on, the receipt screen adds an optional Improve with ChatGPT action. Nothing is sent automatically. When you choose it, PersonalHub shares the text read from the receipt, the names of products already saved in your catalog and the small number PersonalHub uses to tell each saved product apart. It does not share the receipt image. ChatGPT can suggest clearer product names and recognize when differently written lines are the same product. You paste its reply back into PersonalHub and review the result before saving.

PRIVACY AND ACCESS
Leaving this off keeps receipt processing on the device. Turning it on does not make PersonalHub store your ChatGPT password or contact ChatGPT on its own. ChatGPT availability and limits depend on the account you choose to use. You can change this choice at any time.
PersonalHub sends nothing automatically. Choose ChatGPT in the share panel, send the prepared text, then paste its reply here.
Paste the reply produced from the prepared receipt text. PersonalHub checks that every suggested saved product really exists in your catalog before applying it.
This reply cannot be applied. Ask ChatGPT to return the requested format without extra text.
